thread.title: Analysts’ Price Target Changes for January, 11th (AAPL, AMP, ATVI, BNP, CMG, DG, DGE, DPZ, DRW3, DUE)

author: Cynthia Hall
title: Analysts’ Price Target Changes for January, 11th (AAPL, AMP, ATVI, BNP, CMG, DG, DGE, DPZ, DRW3, DUE)
text:
Analysts’ price target changes for Friday, January 11th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $228.00 price target by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Get Apple Inc alerts: Ameriprise Financial (NYSE:AMP) had its target price cut by Morgan Stanley from $170.00 to $150.00. They currently have an overweight rating on the stock.
Activision Blizzard (NASDAQ:ATVI) had its price target lowered by BMO Capital Markets from $52.00 to $2.60. BMO Capital Markets currently has a market perform rating on the stock.
BNP Paribas (EPA:BNP) was given a €74.00 ($86.05) price target by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Chipotle Mexican Grill (NYSE:CMG) had its price target increased by Wells Fargo & Co from $420.00 to $464.00. They currently have a market perform rating on the stock.
Dollar General (NYSE:DG) had its target price increased by Wells Fargo & Co from $118.00 to $129.00. The firm currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
Diageo (LON:DGE) was given a GBX 3,100 ($40.51) target price by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Domino’s Pizza (NYSE:DPZ) had its price target reduced by Wells Fargo & Co from $255.00 to $230.00. Wells Fargo & Co currently has a market perform rating on the stock.
Draegerwerk AG & Co KGaA (ETR:DRW3) was given a €55.00 ($63.95) price target by analysts at Nord/LB. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Duerr (ETR:DUE) was given a €44.00 ($51.16) target price by analysts at Kepler Capital Markets. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Engie (EPA:ENGI) was given a €15.90 ($18.49) target price by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Ingersoll-Rand (NYSE:IR) had its price target lowered by Barclays PLC from $115.00 to $110.00. Barclays PLC currently has an overweight rating on the stock.
L Brands (NYSE:LB) had its price target reduced by Credit Suisse Group AG from $36.00 to $30.00. They currently have a neutral rating on the stock.
Mcdonald’s (NYSE:MCD) had its target price boosted by Wells Fargo & Co from $202.00 to $203.00. The firm currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
Renault (EPA:RNO) was given a €85.00 ($98.84) target price by analysts at Kepler Capital Markets. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Software (ETR:SOW) was given a €38.00 ($44.19) price target by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Spotify (NASDAQ:SPOT) had its price target lowered by Morgan Stanley from $200.00 to $170.00. Morgan Stanley currently has an overweight rating on the stock.
Peugeot (EPA:UG) was given a €25.00 ($29.07) price target by analysts at Kepler Capital Markets. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Wirecard (ETR:WDI) was given a €176.00 ($204.65) target price by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Zurich Insurance Group (VTX:ZURN) was given a CHF 390 price target by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
